Container.Name: autoextract
Container.Overview: Scans your folders on a schedule and automatically extracts zip, rar, 7z and tar archives into the folder they are in, then extracts any archives found inside those, and cleans up (deletes or moves) the processed archives and junk files such as *.diz. Works one folder at a time, with parallel extraction inside a folder, a live status page, and a settings page for every option. Created entirely by AI (Claude). It has been tested, but not in every situation - do your own due diligence before relying on it with data you cannot replace, and before exposing it to the internet.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI (status + settings).

Config.Name: Folder to scan
Config.Description: A folder to scan (including sub-folders). Needs read/write. Use 'Add another Path' for more folders, then list them on the Settings page.

Config.Name: Processed folder (optional)
Config.Description: Only if you want processed archives MOVED instead of deleted. Must not be inside a scanned folder. Use the same kind of path as the scan folders (all /mnt/user or all /mnt/diskN).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Used for the times shown in logs.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Login for the web UI (used only when a password is set).

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the web UI. Strongly recommended.

Config.Name: First run: source folders
Config.Description: Comma separated container paths to scan. Only used to seed the settings on the very first start - change them later on the Settings page.

Config.Name: First run: scan automatically
Config.Description: true = scan on an interval. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: interval (minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes between scans. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: threads
Config.Description: Parallel extractions within a folder. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: archive action
Config.Description: delete or move. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: junk action
Config.Description: delete or move. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: move folder
Config.Description: Container path used when an action is 'move', e.g. /processed. First start only.

Config.Name: First run: junk patterns
Config.Description: Comma separated file name patterns. First start only.

Config.Name: Owner user ID (optional)
Config.Description: Set (e.g. 99) to also change the owner of processed files. Unraid's nobody = 99. First start only.

Config.Name: Owner group ID (optional)
Config.Description: Set (e.g. 100) with the user ID above. Unraid's users = 100. First start only.
